Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically compares the protein composition of an RNA pull-down between miR-122 deficient (HepG2) and miR-122 expressing (HepG2-miR-122) cells. While the study also performs siRNA depletion of TNRC6 proteins, those experiments are validated via RT-qPCR, immunoblotting, and luciferase assays, not the mass spectrometry dataset described in the PRIDE metadata and LFQ section. Therefore, only the miR-122 expression variable is extracted as the primary biological variable for the MS experiment. Mapping is kept at the parent level (ligand_stimulation) as miR-122 is a microRNA, which does not fit the specific fine-grained classes like cytokines or growth factors.
